description: Tell AgentViva that a tool it watches publicly does not work for you or your user, by name ("Notion") or address ("notion.so"), with an optional short note of what happened. AgentViva checks it again right away (at most once an hour per tool) and answers with what that check saw. A report never changes the tool's state by itself: only AgentViva's own checks do, and several must agree. One report per network, tool and day is counted. No API key needed. For a tool AgentViva does not watch, use check_url instead.

note.description: What happened, in a few words (optional).

query.description: A tool name or an address.

name: report_problem
title: Report that a tool does not work
